local_dishes.name: Ceviche
local_dishes.description: Peru's national dish of fresh raw fish marinated in lime juice, onions, chilli and cilantro.

local_dishes.name: Ají de Gallina
local_dishes.description: Shredded chicken in a creamy yellow chilli sauce, served with potatoes and rice.

local_dishes.name: Causa Rellena
local_dishes.description: Cold appetizer of layers of mashed yellow Peruvian potatoes (often with aji amarillo and lime) with mayonnaise-based fillings such as tuna, chicken, crab or prawns

local_dishes.name: Papa a la Huancaína
local_dishes.description: Boiled potatoes topped with a creamy, mildly spicy cheese sauce made with yellow chillies.

local_dishes.name: Tacu Tacu
local_dishes.description: Peruvian take on rice and beans made with leftover rice and beans, often served with a fried egg and salsa

local_dishes.name: Arroz Chaufa
local_dishes.description: Popular Chifa fried rice with bell peppers, soy sauce and egg, made with various meats

local_dishes.name: Pisco Sour
local_dishes.description: Peru's signature cocktail made with pisco, lime juice, sugar syrup, egg white and bitters.

local_dishes.name: Chicha Morada
local_dishes.description: Non-alcoholic traditional drink of boiled purple corn, pineapple skin, cinnamon, cloves and sugar; sweet and fruity

local_dishes.name: Inca Kola
local_dishes.description: Bright yellow, super-sweet fizzy soda tasting like bubblegum; outsells Coca-Cola in Peru

local_dishes.name: Chilcano
local_dishes.description: Refreshing Pisco-based cocktail, lighter than a Pisco Sour, made with Pisco, ginger ale, lime juice and bitters

local_dishes.name: Causa Limeña
local_dishes.description: Layers of seasoned yellow potato filled with chicken, tuna, seafood or avocado.

local_dishes.name: Anticuchos
local_dishes.description: Skewers of marinated beef heart or chicken grilled over charcoal, served with potatoes and corn.

local_dishes.name: Lomo Saltado
local_dishes.description: Stir-fried beef with onions, tomatoes, soy sauce, fries and rice; a Peruvian-Chinese fusion.
local_dishes.where_to_try: Lima – Casa Tambo Restaurant | Cusco – Cicciolina, Morena Peruvian Kitchen

local_dishes.name: Suspiro Limeño
local_dishes.description: Dessert of dulce de leche topped with fluffy meringue and a hint of cinnamon.
local_dishes.where_to_try: Lima – Panchita | Cusco – Chicha by Gastón Acurio

local_dishes.name: Peruvian Coffee
local_dishes.description: Single-origin Arabica coffee grown in the Andes and Amazon regions, with a smooth body and balanced flavour.
local_dishes.where_to_try: Lima – local speciality cafés in Miraflores | Cusco – ChocoMuseo Café
